paragraphs: He is mentioned in Aggadat Bereshit, chapter 2; Seder HaDorot wrote: “I have not found it.”[^1]

notes.text: Chiyya’s heading title is abbreviated and retained as R'. Aggadat Bereshit chapter2 and the Seder HaDorot quotation I have not found it are Hyman’s reported citation and source statement. Neither work was independently checked here; the quoted failure is not converted to this reviewer’s absence claim.
